reasoning_content: Let's wait for the app to start up, then check /health/ready again and also check the logs.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "live up after ~$((i*5))s"; break; }
  sleep 5
done
echo "=== /health/ready (db/redis/keycloak/jobWorker) ==="
curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/health/ready | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log('status=',j.status);console.log('checks=',JSON.stringify({db:j.checks.db,redis:j.checks.redis,keycloak:j.checks.keycloak,diag:j.checks.diagnostics,errs:j.checks.errors},null,1));})"
